title: The Arithmetic Before Notation

features.name: the counting stone
features.desc-on-touch: five notches read forwards as one, backwards as another; the stone does not care which way the hand moves

features.name: sequence that argues with itself
features.desc-on-touch: numbers scratched into wood: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11... but also 2, 3, 5, 8, 13; both run true; neither is false

features.name: the silence between operations
features.desc-on-touch: the pause where breath stops; here, mathematics exists without yet being born into symbols

features.name: equations in storm-wood
features.desc-on-touch: before they were written, these rules existed only as breath; written, they became smaller

features.name: the antenna that hears silence
features.desc-on-touch: it transmits nothing; it receives everything; static is the music of empty calculation

inscription: before language learned to count, numbers counted themselves in the dark and were satisfied

file.name: FencePost_Line_Both_Directions.txt
